candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Load the candidate demo build — zero public canary traffic; presentation/motion-only change with no API side effects
candidateVerificationJourney.notes: Issue's own Release evidence section: 'load the candidate demo, confirm the new surface renders with the scoped tokens and the dashboard is visually unchanged.' Transcribed verbatim into the journeys below — no additional surfaces inferred.

journeys.name: run-surface-scoped-tokens-render
assertions: run surface renders with the scoped focus-surface tokens (quieter ground, reduced chrome, deeper neutral)
the live-edge accent token appears only on the active stepper node / streaming caret / armed CTA, nowhere else on the page
focus rings remain visible on interactive elements on the new surface

journeys.name: in-progress-sub-tab-scoped-tokens-render
assertions: sub-tab renders with the same scoped token layer as the recommendations run surface
motion primitives observed only fire on a real event/state transition, never on a bare timer

journeys.name: dashboard-visually-unchanged
assertions: computed token values on this route are byte-identical to the pre-change build (dashboard and the other ten workflows' surfaces are unaffected by the scoped layer)

staticAssetChecks.notes: Issue text: 'the built CSS must carry the scoped layer — assert by checking the built artifact, not the source.' The scoped token layer and motion primitive styles must be discoverable in the built CSS output, not only in packages/theme source files.

migrationCompatibility.notes: Issue text: 'No migration.' This is a token layer and motion primitive change in packages/theme and apps/demo only — no database schema, no persisted-shape change.

rollbackAssertion.notes: Issue text: 'reverting removes the scoped layer only; assert app-wide tokens are untouched so a rollback cannot restyle the rest of the app.' The same byte-identical app-wide token test that gates the forward change also gates rollback safety.

doNotInfer: release evidence fields beyond what the issue's Release evidence (ADR-035) section states
any app-wide token value change — the layer is scoped only
any use of the live-edge accent token for ordinary emphasis
any motion primitive driven by a timer alone with no event or state-transition trigger
a palette that contradicts PUI-DESIGN.md — no new external design reference was gathered for this wave
editing apps/dashboard or ios/ to prove the dashboard is unchanged — verification reads apps/dashboard's rendered output, it does not modify it
